name: Ozark Solar
old_description: Providing solar solutions to northwest Arkansas & the surrounding areas.
about:
Ozark Solar is based in Bella Vista, Arkansas. Founded in 2007 by Josh Whittle, who serves as owner, the company began with a focus on bringing energy independence to a four-state region covering Arkansas, Oklahoma, Missouri, and Kansas.

The firm provides solar installation and roofing services. Its offerings include grid-tied solar systems, hybrid off-grid/grid-tied systems, commercial solar installations, residential roofing repair and replacement, off-grid solar systems using Fortress Power equipment, whole-home Generac generator installations, and solar panel detachment and reset services. The company reports that its installations have generated over 1.7 gigawatts of solar energy to date.

Ozark Solar serves residential and commercial customers across its service area. Residential clients include homeowners seeking grid-tied or off-grid power, as well as remote cabins, farms, and homesteads. Commercial clients range from small businesses to larger facilities requiring roofing and solar solutions.

The company emphasizes integrity and transparency, stating it is fully bonded and offers financing options with $0 down for qualified applicants. It also assists customers in claiming the 30% federal investment tax credit. A noted operational differentiator is a 7- to 14-day turnaround for solar panel detachment and reset work.
